evidence.source: Contract 205 applied to Development on 19 August 2026 from exact main 88576cf5ebd762987345116c002ae0890416aa03. THE LANE WAS SWITCHED, AND THAT IS RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN LEFT TO INFERENCE: the ADR 0024 fast lane was dispatched twice and both runs hung on 'Take the lightweight pre-apply snapshot' -- runs 32244708088 (26+ minutes) and 32245758861 (~20 minutes), both cancelled. That step is two `supabase db dump` calls; read-only SQL against the same project through the Supabase API worked throughout, so the database was reachable and the CLI dump specifically was hanging. Both runs reached the snapshot only AFTER proving contract 205 additive, and neither reached 'Apply the pending migrations', so Development was untouched at 204 each time and both cancellations were free. Contract 205 was then applied by the GUARDED lane, development-migration-rollout.yml run 32246603342, which the fast lane itself defers to and which carries no dump step: it names the boundary by filename (20260819100000_cup_bracket_seed_initial_phase.sql), proves the expected source contract 204 against the live database, dry runs, and holds back anything above the target. It is stricter about WHAT is applied, not looser. What it gives up is the snapshot, which is acceptable for DEVELOPMENT because ADR 0024 makes the deterministic seed the recovery authority there; it would not be acceptable for Production, whose rollback authority is the encrypted backup, and the Production workflows keep their own dump steps untouched. It completed in 18 seconds. CONFIRMED BY AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY QUERY RATHER THAN FROM THE JOB OUTPUT, naming the ledger row: 205 rows with newest 20260819100000 cup_bracket_seed_initial_phase. CONTRACT 205 IS THE FIRST IN THIS RANGE TO TOUCH A PLAYER-FACING READ -- it redefines public.get_season_cup_bracket(uuid), so that grant was measured rather than assumed: executable by authenticated and NOT by anon. EVERY PLAYER-OWNED COUNT IS UNCHANGED against the contract-204 record: 24 auth users, 24 profiles, 34 entries, 64 season predictions, 756 match predictions, 8 matchweek scores, 20 competition entrants, 0 bonus score events, 5 leagues, 39 league members, 1 Cup launch, 112 Cup fixtures and 578 season fixtures. Cron still holds 14 jobs and PAID COLLECTION REMAINS DISABLED with ai.api_usage still 0, so this apply cost no provider credit. Both publication gates remain false. The AI Lab custody from contract 204 survives 205 landing on top of it: ai.quarantined_predictions is readable by neither anon nor authenticated, and schema ai still carries zero table grants to either.
